George Gissing, The Private Papers of Henry Ryecroft.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/george-gissing/the-private-papers-of-henry-ryecroft

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- George Gissing, the author, died 1903 (Wikidata Q369790, P570 = 1903-12-28).

First publication of the text used: 1903, United Kingdom (SE colophon: 'The Private Papers of Henry Ryecroft was published in 1903 by George Gissing.'; Wikipedia infobox for The Private Papers of Henry Ryecroft: publication place England, publication date 1903, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Private_Papers_of_Henry_Ryecroft).

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1903, before 1931;
  a published work enters the United States public domain 95 years after
  publication, so this work entered it in 1998.
- Country of origin (United Kingdom): copyright there lasts for life plus 70 years
  after the death of the last surviving person named above. The last to die
  did so in 1903, so the work entered the public domain there on
  1 January 1974.
